components.name: Skeleton
components.description:
Skeleton — content placeholder while data loads. Bones fill/soft-pressed with a shimmer (opacity 1 → 0.5 → 1, 1.2s ease-in-out). Match the real layout: Text, Title, Circle, Rect, List row, Card. Never mix skeleton with a spinner on the same block.
Resizable: set the instance width (or FILL) — bones stretch, the last line of Text and the second line of List row keep their short length. Card media k

Design System
5.7 Loading
Spinner (6 variants · Tone × Size), Skeleton (6 shapes) and Pull to refresh (3 states).
Overview
Show progress the moment a wait is longer than 300 ms. Skeleton when the layout is known, Spinner when it is not, Pull to refresh for user-started reloads.
Spinner
Unknown layout or short actions: buttons, full-screen waits.
Skeleton
Known layout: lists, cards, profiles.
